mechanism: veth pair + iptables in a dedicated network namespace; NOT bare unshare --net (AF-AP-1)

architecture.host_side: veth-host 10.200.0.1/24 — runs the OmniRoute stand-in on port 12800 and a blocked listener on 12801
architecture.netns_side: veth-egress 10.200.0.2/24 — iptables OUTPUT/INPUT allow only 10.200.0.1:12800 (TCP), default DROP
architecture.stand_in: Python HTTP server returning {object: list, data: [{id: omniroute-standin}]}
architecture.blocked_listener: Python HTTP server on port 12801 returning {id: blocked-model} — reachable only when iptables gate is OFF

runs.label: positive-leg
runs.command: ip netns exec egress-spike curl http://10.200.0.1:12800/v1/models
runs.notes: Unit inside netns reaches the allowed OmniRoute stand-in through the veth pair

runs.label: negative-leg-blocked-port
runs.command: ip netns exec egress-spike curl --connect-timeout 5 http://10.200.0.1:12801/v1/models
runs.denial_reason: Failed to connect to 10.200.0.1 port 12801 after 5002 ms: Timeout was reached
runs.notes: Same unit fails to reach a non-allowed port on the same host — iptables DROP causes timeout (the listener IS running, but the namespace firewall blocks it)

runs.label: negative-leg-external
runs.command: ip netns exec egress-spike curl --connect-timeout 5 http://1.1.1.1/
runs.denial_reason: Failed to connect to 1.1.1.1 port 80 after 0 ms: Couldn't connect to server
runs.notes: Same unit fails to reach any external IP — no route out of the namespace and iptables DROP

runs.label: gate-off-mutation
runs.command: iptables -F + -P ACCEPT inside netns, then curl the previously-blocked port
runs.notes: Gate-off mutation: dropping iptables rules makes the blocked port reachable — proves the gate was the barrier, not a structural artifact (de-vacuous negative control per anti-hollow-green tactic 1)

facts.af_ap_1_respected: bare unshare --net NOT used; veth pair provides selective connectivity

classification_effect.label: mechanism proven, containment unproven
classification_effect.reason: veth + iptables selective egress mechanism works in the sandbox: allowed traffic passes, blocked traffic is denied by the namespace firewall, and the gate-off mutation proves the gate is the barrier. Full canary suite over live production units is Wave 2 (increment #16)
